page.layout: One page of running text in one column, with no margin notes. The top line is the tail of a sentence from the previous page, in italic. Below it, one running paragraph of Latin with a Greek word and a hyphenated line end.

main_text.p: In hac appendice enumerantur quadraginta octo afterismi siue constellationes cœlestes: quarum viginti una sunt in septentrione, & copulantur stellas trecentas & sexaginta: duodecim constellationes sunt in zodiaco, quæ suppeditant stellas trecentas & quadraginta sex: in parte meridionali sunt quindecim constellationes, quæ suggerunt stellas trecentas & sedecim. Itaque stellæ totius firmamenti sunt mille & viginti duæ: sicut Ptolemæus tradit, qui eas diligentissime recensuit. Nec est cur hunc numerum stellarum rideamus, quod in sacris literis scribatur, eas esse innumerabiles: non enim dubium est, quin plurimæ fugiant, quæ penitus imprefsæ sunt sphæræ octauæ. Si vero aliqui plures stellas possint ostendere, quam ab astronomis hactenus sint obseruatæ, magnaipsis gratiam referemus. Epitome Arabica Almagefti hoc ordine, & his nominibus stellas extra zodiacum positas enumerat: in parte septentrionali est dub alalgar, & dub alechber, h.e. vrsa minor, & vrsa maior: tanin, h.e. draco: Cepheus: Alhhava, h.e. vociferator siue bootes: Alpheccha, h.e. corona septentrionalis: Alcheri hale rechabateh, h.e. procidens in genu suum, siue est Hercules: Schaliaf, h.e. lyra: aldigaga, h.e. gallina: Dhath alchursi, h.e. domina sellæ, quæ est Cassiopeia: Chamil ras algol, h.e. deferes caput Algol, hic est Perseus: Memaslich alhanan, h.e. retinens habenas, qui Græcis dicitur Heniochus, siue auriga: Alhhakkab, h.e. aquila: Aldelphin, h.e. delphinus: Alsoham, h.e. telum: Alhava, h.e. serpentarius: Alhaja, h.e. serpens: Kataat alfaras, hoc est [illegible, ~7 letters] ἵππος[?], ut appellat Ptolemæus: Alfaras alathem, h.e. equus maior: Almara al-mefulsela, h.e. fœmina catenata, ea est quæ Androme-dadi-

page.notes: Several Arabic star names and Greek words are doubtful; the Greek word before "ἵππος" is illegible. The word "deferes" and "Kataat" are uncertain. The line end "Androme-" / "dadi-" is copied as printed. The top line is a fragment from the previous page. The printed forms "afterifmi", "vna", "vt", "eft" have been normalised to s, u/v and est, per the rules. Printed "ꝓ" or abbreviations were not present beyond "h.e.".
